note: The How to play card (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 17): every word it shows, as data, so a tone change or a translation is a data swap. Pages hold items; an item is an icon (drawn by UiHowto) and a line. Keys on the controls page come from Controls' map through ui/data/glyphs.json. Orb's direction for the copy: the player IS the fighter. Say bluntly what they control (fly, dash, stances, light or heavy, charge, signature, specials, transform) and what is automatic (no combo inputs: the blows and combos play out on their own). Never frame the player as directing someone else; 'director' and 'strategist' are internal words.
title: HOW TO PLAY
reopen: Open this again from the pause menu or F1.

items.text: You are the fighter. Fly, dash, pick a stance, choose light or heavy, charge, use specials, call your signature, transform.
No combo inputs to learn. Blows and combos play out on their own.
No health bars. Damage shows on the bodies.
A finisher ends the fight, not a clock.
Player 2: arrows, Enter, comma, period, slash, and 7 8 9 0.
A ring flashes when a body part gets worse.
A faint ring: on the brink. A finisher can end it.
Read your rival: stance, weight, finisher kind.
Finisher rings show hold or slip. GUARD a launch, DODGE a melee, PRESS a beam.
The top chip counts what the fight costs the world.
The strip is the whole planet. It wraps.
